notes.title: Nethergate: Resurrection v1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Our ancient classic has just received a quick update. We have changed the resolution switching when launching the game. You can now choose exactly what setting to switch your monitor to.

The code base from Nethergate: Resurrection dates way back to 1998. This game plays in a FIXED 800x600 pixel area. You will probably need to try different monitor resolutions to find one that fits well. The game's guess of what resolution will work best will be the first one on the monitor selection list.

Thanks for trying this classic from the early history of indie RPGs!
